title: OL-20261114-2: CONNECT-2: dashboard panel for /auth/connectors and a per-tenant connect button
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** next executor pass
**Done check:** grep:dashboard/worker.js::auth/connectors
**Status:** closed

The status JSON exists; the owner dashboard does not render it yet, and connector tokens are not yet exposed to tenant tools through a getToken-backed API.

**Evidence:** dashboard/worker.js connectorsPanel reads the tick Worker /auth/connectors and serves GET /api/owner/connectors plus the Connections section. Per-tenant connect buttons and the token interface for tenant tools continue as Q-CONNECT-3. Done check corrected to name the file (a directory path can never match).
